props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by asChild.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Controls whether the desktop sidebar is collapsed.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Initial desktop collapsed state when collapsed is uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial mobile open state when open is uncontrolled.

props.name: disableOutsidePointerEvents
props.description: When true, hover/focus/click interactions will be disabled on elements outside the DismissableLayer. Users will need to click twice on outside elements to interact with them: once to close the DismissableLayer, and again to trigger the element.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when controlling animation with Vue animation libraries.

props.name: mobileDescription
props.description: Accessible description announced when the sidebar opens on mobile.

props.name: mobileTitle
props.description: Accessible title announced when the sidebar opens on mobile.

props.name: mobileWidth
props.description: The sidebar width below the mobile breakpoint.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the mobile sidebar is open.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge of the layout that contains the sidebar.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual relationship between the sidebar and main content.
